title: Yi's +4 Might is applied unconditionally, ignoring the 'While you have 8+ runes' condition
expected: yi-meditative.ts declares no `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts parses rulesText; parser output (verified via bun) is a static ability with condition `{type:"custom", text:"While you have 8+ runes"}` and effect modify-might +4 self. evaluateCondition (static-abilities.ts:105-316) has no "custom"/rune-count case, and the `default` branch at static-abilities.ts:312-315 returns true ("Unknown condition — default to true"), so recalculateStaticEffects applies staticMightBonus=4 regardless of rune count.
observed: Immediately after playUnit on turn 1 with 2 runes in pool, meta.staticMightBonus=4 and the board tile displayed 8 Might

history.note: already fixed at HEAD by commit 2456919 (runes-at-least static condition + explicit abilities on yi-meditative); all 7 Yi tests pass
